title: Notification Intent
description: A channel-agnostic corporate notification intent (e.g. 'approval.requested', 'password.expiring', 'event.critical'). The notification hub routes one intent to one-or-more channel adapters (email, Slack, Teams, Discord, WhatsApp, push). Producers express WHAT to notify and to WHOM (by principal, resolved against directory.org-node); the hub resolves HOW. For WhatsApp outside the customer-service window a template is mandatory.

principal_id.description: Resolved against directory.org-node; the hub looks up channel addresses.

address.description: Optional explicit address (email/phone/handle) overriding directory lookup.

channels.description: Requested channels; empty = hub decides by recipient preference and intent policy.

template.description: Template id; required for WhatsApp outside the service window.
